breakdown.description: The sinusoidal traction is moved from the specified global x-coordinate to a local edge coordinate
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction, first defining the traction based on the global x-coordinate (`sin(πx)`) and then asking to parameterize it using a local arclength coordinate. The ground truth resolves this by explicitly stating to use the global coordinate. The generated specification correctly follows this, stating: 'A surface traction is applied on the hypotenuse with σ_yy = -5e3*sin(π*x) Pa, where x is the global x-coordinate as explicitly stated in the load definition.' This resolves the contradiction.
